standard.name: IATF 16949
standard.description: Automotive Quality Management System - Supplement to ISO 9001:2015

categories.name: Automotive Requirements
categories.description: Automotive-specific quality management requirements supplementing ISO 9001

clauses.title: Context of the Organization
clauses.description: Internal and external issues affecting QMS, interested parties, scope
clauses.helpText: Automotive-specific context including OEM customer-specific requirements

clauses.title: Leadership
clauses.description: Top management accountability, commitment, corporate responsibility, quality policy
clauses.helpText: Management responsibility for quality and customer satisfaction

clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
clauses.description: Top management demonstrates leadership and commitment with respect to QMS
clauses.helpText: Management involvement in continuous improvement and zero defects culture

clauses.title: Corporate responsibility
clauses.description: Organization policy for corporate responsibility including anti-bribery, ethics, and employee code of conduct
clauses.helpText: Ethics policy, anti-corruption policies, escalation process

clauses.title: Process effectiveness
clauses.description: Top management ensures processes achieve intended outputs and create value
clauses.helpText: Process performance metrics and effectiveness reviews

clauses.title: Planning
clauses.description: Risk management, preventive actions, contingency plans, quality objectives
clauses.helpText: Risk-based thinking with contingency planning for key processes

clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
clauses.description: Determine risks and opportunities, plan actions, integrate into QMS, evaluate effectiveness
clauses.helpText: FMEA (Design, Process), control plans, risk analysis

clauses.title: Support
clauses.description: Resources, infrastructure, competence, awareness, communication, documented information
clauses.helpText: Adequate resources including skilled personnel and quality equipment

clauses.title: Operation
clauses.description: Operational planning, product requirements, design, production, control of nonconforming products
clauses.helpText: APQP, PPAP, manufacturing process controls, special characteristics

clauses.title: Design and development
clauses.description: Design planning, inputs, outputs, reviews, verification, validation
clauses.helpText: APQP process, DVP&R, design FMEA, design reviews

clauses.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
clauses.description: Supplier management, supplier quality, approved suppliers
clauses.helpText: Supplier development, supplier audits, supplier performance monitoring

clauses.title: Production and service provision
clauses.description: Control plans, work instructions, verification, validation, identification, traceability, preservation
clauses.helpText: Layered process audits, mistake-proofing (poka-yoke), preventive maintenance

clauses.title: Control plans
clauses.description: Control plans for all products and processes including characteristics, measurements, reaction plans
clauses.helpText: Process control plans with special characteristics, SPC monitoring

clauses.title: Release of products and services
clauses.description: PPAP submission, layout inspection, functional testing, appearance approval
clauses.helpText: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP)submission and customer approval

clauses.title: Control of nonconforming outputs
clauses.description: Nonconforming product control, customer notification, authorization for concession
clauses.helpText: 8D problem solving, containment, customer notification for suspect parts

clauses.title: Performance Evaluation
clauses.description: Monitoring, measurement, analysis, evaluation, internal audit, management review
clauses.helpText: Customer scorecards, PPM tracking, warranty data analysis

clauses.title: Monitoring and measurement of manufacturing processes
clauses.description: Statistical process control for special characteristics
clauses.helpText: SPC charts, process capability studies (Cpk), reaction plans for out-of-control

clauses.title: Internal audit
clauses.description: QMS audits, manufacturing process audits, product audits
clauses.helpText: VDA 6.3 process audits, layered process audits (LPA), product audits

clauses.title: Improvement
clauses.description: Continual improvement, nonconformity, corrective action, problem solving
clauses.helpText: 8D methodology, root cause analysis (5 Why, Ishikawa), lessons learned

clauses.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
clauses.description: Problem solving, root cause analysis, corrective actions, effectiveness verification
clauses.helpText: 8D reports, customer complaints handling, warranty claim analysis

clauses.title: Problem solving
clauses.description: Defined problem solving process, methods, tools including 8D
clauses.helpText: 8D process implementation, problem solving tools (Ishikawa, 5 Why, etc.)

clauses.title: Error-proofing
clauses.description: Use error-proofing methods in corrective action process
clauses.helpText: Poka-yoke implementation, mistake-proofing devices and methods

clauses.title: Warranty management system
clauses.description: Process for warranty claims analysis and reduction
clauses.helpText: Warranty data analysis, trends, feedback to design and manufacturing

clauses.title: Customer complaints and field failure test analysis
clauses.description: Analysis of customer complaints and field returns
clauses.helpText: Field failure analysis, returned parts analysis, corrective actions implementation

clauses.title: Continual improvement
clauses.description: Demonstrate continual improvement of QMS effectiveness
clauses.helpText: CI projects, kaizen events, manufacturing performance improvement trends
